key_findings.claim: The HT_COMM wire serializer (0x009b2f98) and deserializer (0x009b3c88) use 51-entry jump tables (opcodes 0..50) with exactly 36 active opcodes per mode (37 in union across PtP, PtMP AP, and PtMP STA: opcode 14 is PtMP-only, while opcode 42 is PtP/STA-only).

Target HT_COMM RX state-machine dispatcher (0x009b1024, JT @ 0x009b1067 PtP / 0x009b1e8b AP / 0x009b1fb2 STA) handles 18 host-to-target command opcodes directly on the Xtensa CPU, with opcode 13 (0x0d -> 0x009b1c80) invoking platform_install_hooks (0x009af2f8 @ 0x009b1d25) to activate the 32 Full Polling Hooks.

Target-to-host HT_COMM events are transmitted by ubnt_poll_ht_comm_tx (0x009b43a0 in ht_comm.c), which serializes the payload via 0x009b2f98, allocates target WMI event 0x901f (mapped by host umac.ko to WMI_UBNT_HT_COMM_EVENTID = 0x902b), and delivers it to ubnt_poll_host_ht_comm_rx (0x0e67c).
